description: PATCH /v1/webhooks/:id - changes the url, the subscribed events, the description or the pinned apiVersion, or enables/disables the endpoint; send only what changes. events replaces the whole subscription. A disabled endpoint receives nothing and its pending deliveries are marked failed without retry. The signing secret and the endpoint mode do not change. Changing url or events can break a live integration; confirm with user. Requires an API key (sk_*).

apiVersion.description: Pin the payload shape to "2026-10-02", or null to follow the latest shape.

events.description: Full replacement list; see webhooks_create for each event.

name: webhooks_update
title: Update webhook endpoint
